findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_earthquakes" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_holiday_regions, get_public_holidays, get_earthquakes · Private data: list_historical_indicators, get_record, get_evidence, reconcile_tables · Public sink: get_exchange_rate_history · Destructive: get_interest_rates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_holiday_regions, get_public_holidays, get_earthquakes · Private data: list_historical_indicators, get_record, get_evidence, reconcile_tables · Public sink: get_exchange_rate_history · Destructive: get_interest_rates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
